title: Leptin Signaling Pathway Protocol
author: Fawaz G. Haj
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ybqfsmw

steps.title: Euthanize mice
steps.instruction: Euthanize mice using cervical dislocation, unless otherwise requested by the PI.

steps.title: Collect blood and isolate plasma
steps.instruction: Collect maximum blood from the portal vein and isolate plasma following standard protocols or as specified by the PI.

steps.title: Collect and process tissues
steps.instruction: Quickly collect tissues designated by the PI, ensuring the entire collection procedure is completed within a maximum of 3 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Divide each tissue into three portions.
Snap freeze the first portion in liquid nitrogen.
Place the second portion into RNA later solution.
Place the third portion into the appropriate fixative solution.

steps.title: Prepare tissues for western blotting
steps.instruction: Lyse tissues intended for western blotting into the appropriate lysis buffer.

steps.title: Determine protein expression and phosphorylation
steps.instruction: Determine total protein expression of Leptin Receptor, JAK2, and STAT3, as well as phosphorylation of JAK2 and STAT3 in tissues of interest, following standard Western blotting protocols.
